Are you looking for a more seamless fit of the Junimo Hut into your farm layout?"Junimo Hut Resize" is crafted just for you!

This mod transforms the original 3x2 size of the Junimo Hut to a compact and pleasing 2x2 size.

The meticulous retexture ensures it transitions beautifully from the former 3x5 tiles to its new 2x2 format.

"Junimo Hut Resize" allows for a farm experience that's both functional and visually cohesive. Moreover, our mod seamlessly works alongside favorites like "Better Junimos" and "Better Junimos Forestry", ensuring a smooth gameplay and more customization options.

Stay excited!
Our dedicated team is actively developing fresh retextures for the Junimo Hut. Keep an eye on our updates. We're devoted to elevating your Stardew Valley experience and assisting you in crafting the idyllic farm you've always envisioned!
